Crush Of The Week Montreal Canadiens Edition

May 10, 2010 • Janice Cotcher

Tonight may be the last Montreal Canadiens game of the season, so this be my last chance for a hockey themed Crush of the Week. Please understand that my hockey crushes are similar to a “man crush”; I admire them for their contributions to my team and want to give them hugs when they don’t do well.

Jaroslav Halak: The Habs would not have made it this far without you. A hockey miracle is the best birthday present a girl could hope for. [!]Jaroslav Halak Ryan O’Byrne: Before this season, I just knew you as the guy who scored the embarrassing “own goal” last season.

Despite losing your mom earlier this year to cancer, you have matured as a player. It was totally classy how you changed your jersey number when Emile Bouchard’s number was retired. [!]Ryan O’Byrne Please, just stay out of the penalty box. [!]Ryan O’Byrne fighting Mike Cammalleri: You lead the team in much more than scoring. Your efforts are appreciated to become a community member with your bilingual tweets and singing of O’Canada. I forgive you for once being a Calgary Flame. [!]Mike Cammalleri Scott Gomez: You’re short but feisty. You also give the most amusing interviews by far. [!]Scott Gomez fighting Brian Gionta: Being named assistant captain during your first year with the Habs speaks of your character. I had my doubts when Bob Gainey added three small forwards to the team but you proved me wrong. [!]Brian Gionta It is awesome how you and Gomez took over Alex Kovalev’s charity when he left the team [!]Brian Gionta and Scott Gomez Hal Gill: You’ve been a remarkable presence in the playoffs and hope you are well enough to play tonight. [!]Hal Gill Also, your daughter is adorable

Carey Price

It might seem strange to some that my favourite player is the back-up goalie but that was not always the case; ESPN called you the “Loneliest Man in Sports” and you were once considered the face of the franchise. [!]Carey Price When you returned from injury last season, you seemed to have lost your confidence. You are extremely skilled but need to find that swagger again. [!]Carey Price You always look so sad sitting on the bench. It is heartbreaking to think that you might not be part of the team next season. [!]Carey Price

Probationary Crush of the Week

Maxim Lapierre: You’ve been playing well but you chirp a little too much. You have a tendency to join the fight after the refs get involved. My dad and I were shocked the one time you actually did get in a fight. You need to shed the pretty boy image. [!]Maxim Lapierre in a suit [!]Maxim Lapierre practicing

Honourable Mentions

Kirk Muller (aka Captain Kirk): You’re passion for the team is a good balance for Jacques Martin’s stoic nature. You’re going to make a great head coach some day. You’ll always have a special place in my heart for your series winning goal in the 1993 Stanley Cup Final. [!]Kirk Muller

Saku Koivu: I understand why the Habs didn’t resign you but your leadership is missed. I still get teary-eyed every time I see a clip of the game [!]Saku Koivu
